We may not be professional programmers or aerospace engineers, but we’re comfortable with Python, data, research, and learning new technologies quickly.
summary:
We developed Earth System Intelligence, an interactive environmental data analysis dashboard that helps users explore and understand changes in Earth's environmental patterns across different cities. The platform uses historical datasets from 20 cities and provides interactive visualizations, allowing users to select locations, time periods, and chart types to identify trends and unusual variations. Built using Python, React, and FastAPI, the project also incorporates AI-powered analysis and forecasting capabilities to make environmental data easier to interpret.

The project addresses the challenge of making large and complex environmental datasets accessible and meaningful. By combining data visualization, trend detection, and AI-driven insights, it helps users investigate environmental changes and better understand their potential implications. It is important because informed awareness of environmental trends is a crucial step towards understanding climate-related challenges and encouraging data-driven decision-making.
details:
Earth System Intelligence is an interactive environmental data analysis platform developed by Team Vanguard to help users explore, visualize, and understand environmental trends across 20 cities using historical datasets.

The project allows users to select a city, specify a time period, and choose visualization formats such as line charts to examine changes in environmental parameters over time. Its Python-based backend processes datasets and communicates with the React frontend through FastAPI. A key feature is the integration of our own AI model, Model Go V2, developed as part of the project to support environmental trend analysis and forecasting. We have also integrated NVIDIA Nemotron API to provide AI-assisted analysis and help users interpret patterns and investigate unusual changes.

What makes our project creative is its combination of interactive data visualization, our own AI model, forecasting, and AI-assisted insights in one platform. Instead of presenting users with raw CSV files and complex datasets, it transforms information into accessible visual representations and meaningful insights.

We used Python, React, JavaScript, FastAPI, HTML, CSS, Model Go V2, and the NVIDIA Nemotron API, along with data-processing and forecasting tools. Our team considered data accessibility, accuracy, usability, performance, and the importance of presenting environmental information clearly.

The intended impact is to encourage environmental awareness, promote data-driven exploration, and help users better understand changing patterns in Earth's systems.
